profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Developer
profile.summary: Combining skills in software development and Computer Science with facets of mathematics, statistics, and graphic design.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Overland Park, Kansas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Engineer at Propio Language Services, I architected and built cloud-native microservices that integrate AI capabilities into Propio's interpretation platform. I led the development of an AI-powered quality assurance service that automatically transcribes and evaluates interpreter performance using OpenAI and Amazon Transcribe. Said system now processes all billable calls, enabling our QA team to scale alongside business growth while providing valuable analytics to clients.

I've driven significant DevOps improvements across our infrastructure, migrating services to AWS CodeDeploy with blue-green deployment strategies and championing the adoption of CI/CD pipelines with automated testing and security scanning. I also built comprehensive observability infrastructure using DataDog and CloudWatch, including monitoring dashboards, automated alerting, and runbooks for on-call support.

My tech stack included TypeScript, AWS CDK, Lambda, ECS, Step Functions, and a variety of AWS services for building serverless and containerized applications. I worked extensively with Infrastructure as Code principles and modern deployment practices.

Beyond technical contributions, I focused on team enablement by creating onboarding documentation, mentoring new engineers, and advocating for best practices around CI/CD, security, and system monitoring. I also organized a cross-functional hackathon team that built an internal resource directory used across the company.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained services within HealtheIntent, Oracle Cerner's population health management platform. Worked across a broad technical surface area including RESTful APIs, MySQL databases, data ingestion and processing pipelines, distributed computing with Hadoop, AWS infrastructure, and Docker-based deployments — gaining experience with the architectural complexity of large-scale healthcare data systems.
